meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 让基因组分析在云端标准化自动运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常批量跑测序分析,希望过程可复现且云端自动调度
copy.tagline_en: Automate reproducible genomics analyses in the cloud.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage many genomics analyses and need automated reproducible runs.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能在 DNAnexus 基因云平台上代你操作:上传/下载测序数据(如 FASTQ、BAM、VCF),构建应用,运行并监控分析任务与流程,还会用 dxpy 写自动化脚本。
howto.when: 当你提出要在 DNAnexus 上构建或修改应用、上传下载文件、运行或监控基因分析任务,或处理 FASTQ、BAM、VCF 等生物信息数据时。

say.text: 帮我把本地的 sample.fastq 上传到 DNAnexus 项目里。
say.note: 会上传文件并返回数据对象链接。

say.text: 写一个 dxapp.json,定义这个应用的输入、输出和运行环境。
say.note: Claude 会按你的要求起草应用配置。

say.text: 用 dxpy 运行 applet-xxxx,等它结束并下载结果。
say.note: Claude 会启动任务、等待完成并下载输出文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can operate the DNAnexus cloud genomics platform on your behalf: upload/download sequence files (e.g. FASTQ, BAM, VCF), build apps/applets, run and monitor analyses and workflows, and write Python automation scripts with dxpy.
howto.when_en: When you ask to build or modify DNAnexus apps/applets, upload/download/search files, run or monitor jobs/workflows, write scripts with dxpy, or process bioinformatics files such as FASTQ, BAM, VCF.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to the DNAnexus project I specify.
say_en.note: Uploads the file and returns a data object link.

say_en.text: Write a dxapp.json for my app with its inputs, outputs, and run spec.
say_en.note: Generates an app configuration to start from.

say_en.text: Use dxpy to run applet-xxxx, wait until it finishes, and download the output.
say_en.note: Launches a job, waits, then downloads the result.
